page.overview:
Who is Andaya Forae?

Andaya Forae is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Gray Ajah.

She is 5'5" tall, with hazel eyes. , Andaya | SHORTCUT}} She is described as thin and birdlike. She is not particularly slim nor particularly small and reminds Elaida of a sparrow. She has long light brown hair, which she brushes till it gleams.

Andaya is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Andaya is 99 years old. She was born in Tarabon in the year and she went to the Tower in the year 918. After spending ten years as Novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
